items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: And I told Tyree -- you know, we're pals, we knew each other for years

ctx.x: the matter? What's the matter? What's the matter? She said, 'One engine stop, we go back.' So we went back again. Then we had to wait for another plane and fortunately the wind died down a little bit. That part Okinawa, in that of the world the wind hits there---nothing to stop it; that ocean is just flat, you know. When there's wind, you feel that wind. So we got another plane and this time we made it. So we went back to Tokyo and played Sendai, Hiroshima, Honshu. We played the naval base, at the naval base it…

Iceland, we played two or three days there and this time I think I better cut out because this is a little bit too much for me. So I had my notice in to Louie and from there we went to back to New York and we only had a few hours and we have to get warm clothes, "Where we going?" We're going to St. Thomas, Virgin Islands and St. Croix, Virgin Islands. Then from there, we went from Virgin Islands to Puerto Rico, San Juan. And then from Puerto Rico we went to Miami. Then from Miami begin the southern tours and I…

And you know, the story goes now, Billy Kyle rehearses the band, you know, and the background that I do with Louie, Billy Kyle is trying to tell Glenn, Tyree Glenn how to play that and I understand they had a few words together and I don't blame Tyree Glenn, he kind of got peeved at Billy because Billy wanted Tyree to play the same background that I played
